summary.text: Fang Yuan's first man-made special sea area in Mini Eastern Sea of the sovereign immortal aperture, built from dragon scale soil for his dragonfish group.

claims.text: Dragon scale soil is grainy and tough. A layer of it viewed from afar resembles overlapping dragon scales. It is the soil that dragon type desolate beasts, ancient desolate dragons, or even immemorial desolate dragons lived on, and it carries the aura of dragons. In Mini Eastern Sea the finished dragon scale sea area holds large numbers of dragonfish, including one or two conspicuous desolate beast dragonfish.

Mini Eastern Sea is already a boundless aquatic expanse after Fang Yuan annexes many water path immortal apertures. His plan is to construct a dragon scale sea area, a man-made sea area of the kind Eastern Sea Gu Immortals often build. He lays out dragon scale soil, builds a mortal Gu formation to isolate the area as a special sea area, and leads his dragonfish group there, where they mate more readily. He then activates a modified immortal killer move bountiful year from Hei Fan’s true inheritance so a mysterious power spreads through the whole dragon scale sea area. Right then the first special sea area, dragon scale sea area, has completely formed. From dragon scale lake to dragon scale sea is an enormous leap. He later buys more dragonfish and places them in dragon scale sea area.
After a period of breeding in Fang Yuan’s dragon scale sea area, a special metallic-lustered copper dragonfish variety finally appears.
